reviews.x: I bought this to use around my cuticles when I do nail art (stamping or water marbling). I love this stuff. Since I use it for my nails I pour it into an empty nail polish bottle - when I open the polish bottle, I hardly notice the smell then -but wow does it smell when you open the jar it comes in!  The latex paints on white and dries clear.

This stuff worked perfect for the FX makeup I was doing (I was doing a zombie theme this year) but it stunk something AWFUL. Not recommended for small children just because I had a hard time getting mine to sit through having the stinky stuff slathered all over her face.  As far as durability, it's alright. It lasted all night. Didn't peel or anything, and didn't leave any noticable residue on the skin when peeled off. Just don't get it in your hair! lol

This latex also has less of that fishy smell they latex has; it's there, but very faint.  It goes on white, for easy application, and dries clear. I would highly recommend this product to anyone trying to create realistic looking flesh wounds. Oh, and the smell is gross, but not overpowering. reviews.t: Didnt realize how bad it smelled.
reviews.x: I never knew liquid latex smelled this bad! Aside from that, this applys evenly, and does indeed dry clear, and glossy. I use this as a base coat for swatching of nail polishes, or to apply near my cuticles, to reduce the amount of cleanup. It comes right off, and is not painful at all. This little jar will last me quite some time! Very pleased.
It goes on white and as it dries, it starts to turn clear. I used it for a film shoot. Creepy looking when it peels off!

reviews.t: Much thinner and stinker than other brands
reviews.x: As the title suggests, this liquid latex is much thinner and runnier than other brands. It also has a very strong smell of chemicals. When it dries, this goes away. But, because it's so thin, you need more layers. More layers means more drying time. The chemical smell is also somewhat troubling.  Regardless, it gets the job done and is pretty cheap.

I placed my order late on a Sunday night, and the stuff arrived with Wednesday's mail. It reeks to high heaven, but not so bad once it dries. It did what I wanted it to do with my Halloween costume. What can I say? I got no complaints.
wORKED GREAT FOR HALLOWEEN FACE MAKEUP IDEA MY FIANCE HAD AND DIDNT USE MUCH! CAME OFF PRETTY EASY TOO. WILL HAVE PLENTY FOR NEXT YEAR! THANKS

I use this product when working with henna, to seal and protect a design overnight. For my purposes, I use a medium sized paintbrush to apply. If you do not wash the wet latex off of the brush as soon as you are done applying it, it will never come off! You will still have to peel off some excess, but as long as you wash the brush you'll be able to use it again. Also, this stuff is capable of ripping out body hair, so I recommend shaving any area where you are planning on using it. Overall, a go

Works ok, I bought this because it's supposedly ammonium free but still has quite a strong smell when applied. It does go away after it has dried, though. I found it to be a little too watery/runny (it dripped everywhere as I was applying it) and couldn't get the makeup to sit on it very well once dried. It also started coming off at the corners about 3 hours into my night.

Used this to do a zipper face costume. I did a practice run and thought it wasn't going to work...the zipper wasn't sticking to my skin...but I just needed to give it a minute to start drying and get sticky. Hardly any smell at all and whatever smell I did notice faded very quickly. Zipper stuck all night, even in the rain. Peeling it off was as easy as pulling a bandaid.

Worked great for my zombie Costume! Just don't use it on any part of your body that has hair IE eyebrows,mustache, eyelashes, sideburns. It's worse than pulling off a band aid! But this stuff works great! Also if you do it near a sink, make sure you clean it out after you apply for makeup! It hardens up quick!
